blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Brain metastases are the most common intracranial malignancy, occurring in roughly 30% of patients with primary solid tumors and carrying a median survival near 5.9 months [ 7 , 14 ] . Automated
segmentation is critical for treatment planning and volumetric monitoring, but metastases are frequently small, numerous, and heterogeneous in size within a single patient. We compare a plain nnU-Net baseline, a Residual Encoder Large (ResEncL) variant, region-based training, and a Primus transformer model for BraTS-METS 2026 Task 1, using patient-grouped cross-validation to prevent leakage from the longitudinal UCSD subset.
Primus (label-based) is our strongest individual model by aggregate DSC/NSD, achieving 0.710/0.761 (ET), 0.742/0.785 (TC), 0.683/0.689 (WT), and 0.531/0.436 (RC). ResEncL trails Primus on aggregate DSC/NSD but achieves substantially higher lesion-wise F1 (e.g. ET: 0.452 vs. 0.052); a probability-averaging ensemble of the two only partially preserves ResEncL’s F1
advantage (ET lesion-wise F1: 0.064). We further report three postprocessing and label-reconstruction pitfalls we believe generalize beyond this challenge. Code is available at github.com/mahdiislam79/BraTS_METS_2026 .
blocks.zh:
脑元是最常见的颅内恶性肿瘤,约30%的患者患有初级固体肿瘤,并携带中位存活期近5.9个月[7,14]. 自动化
分化对于治疗规划和体积监测至关重要,但是,在单一患者中,分化的体积往往很小、数量多、体型不同。 我们比较了一个平坦的nU-Net基线,一个残余编码器大型变体(ResEncL),基于区域的培训,以及一个用于BrATS-METS 2026任务1的Primus变压器模型,利用病人分组交叉验证来防止纵向UCSD子集的泄漏.
Primus (label-based) 是按总的DSC/NSD分类的我们最强的单个模型,达到0.710/0.761(ET),0.742/0.785(TC),0.683/0.689(WT)和0.531/0.436(RC). ResEncL在聚合DSC/NSD上跟踪Primus,但能实现显著较高的损伤性F1(如ET:0.452对0.052);两种概率的同位素组合仅部分保留ResEncL的F1.
优点(ET 损害 -- -- F1:0.064)。 我们进一步报告三个后处理和标签重建的陷阱,我们认为这些陷阱超出了这一挑战。 代码见github.com/mahdiislam79/BrATS_METS_2026.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Brain metastases represent the most prevalent intracranial malignancy, arising in an estimated 30% of patients diagnosed with primary solid cancers including lung, breast, and melanoma [ 7 , 11 ] . Their
development is associated with substantially increased healthcare burden, approximately $13,000 higher per-patient costs when central nervous system spread occurs [ 12 ] , and a median overall survival of less than 6 months [ 14 ] . Stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) and whole-brain radiation therapy (WBRT) remain primary treatment modalities, both of which demand precise, reproducible lesion delineation to minimize radiation dose to healthy tissue [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh:
脑元化是最常见的颅内恶性肿瘤,估计30%的患者确诊患有肺癌、乳癌和黑色素瘤等主要固体癌症。 他们的
发展与保健负担大幅增加有关,当中枢神经系统蔓延时,每名病人的费用大约增加13 000美元,总存活率中位数不到6个月[14]。 立体放射外科(SRS)和全脑放射疗法(WBRT)仍然是主要的治疗方式,两者都需要精确,可复制的损伤划定,以尽量减少对健康组织的辐射剂量[10].

blocks.en:
Accurate volumetric segmentation across serial MRI examinations is a prerequisite for automated treatment-response monitoring, enabling clinicians to detect progression or regression of individual metastatic lesions without inter-observer variability. The longitudinal structure of the BraTS-METS 2026 dataset [ 9 ] , particularly the UCSD
subset, which provides multiple imaging timepoints per patient makes it uniquely suited for developing such monitoring pipelines, provided that data splitting is handled to prevent temporal leakage between training and validation folds.
blocks.zh:
一系列核磁共振检查中精确的体积分解是自动治疗-反应监测的先决条件,使临床医生能够检测单个元病变的进展或回归,而不发生观测者之间的变化。 BratS-MEDS 2026数据集的纵向结构[9],特别是UCSD
子集提供每个病人的多个成像时间点,使得它特别适合开发这种监测管道,但必须处理数据分割,以防止培训和验证折叠之间的时间渗漏。

blocks.en:
Recent advances in automated brain tumor segmentation have been driven primarily by nnU-Net [ 3 ] , a self-configuring framework that remains highly competitive across segmentation benchmarks. Architecture extensions, including Residual Encoder variants [ 5 ] , region-based training for overlapping tumor subregion definitions [ 4 ] , and transformer-based models such as SwinUNETR [ 2 ] and Primus [ 13 ] , have demonstrated incremental gains. Multi-architecture ensembling yields the strong reported results in prior BraTS
challenges [ 1 , 6 ] , by combining
complementary failure modes across convolutional and transformer-based models. Persistent challenges remain in small and multifocal lesion detection, handling of the rare resection cavity (RC) class, and robustness to extreme class imbalance between metastatic lesion volume and surrounding brain tissue.
blocks.zh:
最近自动化脑瘤分解方面的进展主要是由nU-Net[3]驱动的,这个自我配置框架在分解基准上仍然具有高度的竞争力. 建筑扩展,包括残余编码器变体[5],关于肿瘤次区域重叠定义的区域培训[4],以及SwinUNETR[2]和Primus[13]等基于变压器的模型,已显示出增量收益。 多结构组合产生以往的BRATS中报告的强劲结果
挑战[1、6],结合
跨转式和变压器型号的互补故障模式. 持续存在的挑战仍然是:小的和多焦的损伤检测、罕见的剖面腔(RC)类的处理、以及运动性损伤体积与周围脑组织之间的极端阶级失衡。

blocks.en:
We present our approach to BraTS-METS 2026 Task 1, segmenting pre- and post-treatment brain metastases into four subregions: enhancing tumor (ET), non-enhancing tumor core (NETC), surrounding non-enhancing FLAIR
hyperintensity (SNFH), and resection cavity (RC). Our pipeline compares a plain nnU-Net baseline, a Residual Encoder Large (ResEncL) variant, a region-based training variant of Primus, and a Primus transformer model, and combines the two strongest individual models (ResEncL and Primus, both label-based) into a probability-averaging ensemble. Beyond this architectural comparison, we report three findings we believe are useful to other implementers building metastasis segmentation pipelines: (i) a patient-grouped cross-validation scheme that prevents the temporal data leakage inherent to the longitudinal UCSD subset of BraTS-METS; (ii) an analysis of a postprocessing failure mode morphological opening silently destroying small lesions near the challenge’s scoring threshold that we argue generalizes to other small-lesion segmentation pipelines; and (iii) identification of a labeling-order assumption in region-based nnU-Net reconstruction that can silently corrupt output classes under non-trivial containment hierarchies, together with a correction procedure requiring no retraining.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了我们处理BrATS-METS 2026 任务1的方法,将处理前和处理后脑元分解为四个次区域:增强肿瘤(ET),不增强肿瘤核(NETC),围绕不增强FLAIR(FLAIR)
超强度(SNFH),和重剖腔(RC). 我们的管道比较了一个平坦的nnU-Net基线、一个残余编码器大型变体(ResEncL),一个基于区域的Primus训练变体和一个Primus变体模型,并将两个最强的单个模型(ResEncL和Primus,两者都以标签为基础)合并成一个概率验证组合。 除了这一结构比较外,我们报告我们认为对建设元沉积分解管道的其他执行者有用的三项调查结果:(一) 患者分组的交叉验证计划,防止BrATS-METS纵向UCSD子集中固有的时间数据泄漏;(二) 分析处理后故障模式的形态开口,静静地摧毁了挑战分数阈值附近的小病变,我们主张将一般化到其他小病变分解管道;(三) 在基于区域的NNU-Net重建中确定一种标签顺序假设,这种假设可以无声地腐蚀非三角封存结构下的产出类别,同时采用不需要再培训的纠正程序。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Dataset and Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集和预处理

blocks.en:
We used the BraTS-METS 2025 Lighthouse dataset [ 8 ] 1 1 1 Synapse ID: syn74274097 . , reused for BraTS 2026 Task 1, comprising 1,496 training cases from nine contributing institutions: Duke, NCI, Missouri, WashU, Yale, UCSF, Northwestern, UCSD, and Ulm [ 9 ] . Of these,
1,296 cases carry expert annotations and were used for supervised training; the 200 Ulm cases are unannotated and were excluded. Four MRI modalities are provided: native T1 (T1n), contrast-enhanced T1 (T1c), T2-weighted (T2w, non-mandatory from 2025 onward), and T2-weighted FLAIR (T2f). Ground truth labels follow a five-class scheme: 0 = background, 1 = NETC, 2 = SNFH, 3 = ET, 4 = RC. RC (label 4) is present in approximately 13% of cases and is retained as a separate class distinct from the whole tumor (WT) hierarchy.
blocks.zh:
我们使用了BrATS-METS 2025灯塔数据集[8] 11 1 突触ID: syn74274097,用于BrATS 2026任务1,包括来自9个贡献机构的1,496个训练案例:杜克,NCI,密苏里,WashU,耶鲁,UCSF,西北,UCSD,和乌尔姆[9]. 其中,
1 296个案件附有专家说明,用于监督培训;200个乌尔姆案件未经说明,不包括在内。 提供了四种磁共振模式:原生T1(T1n),对比增强T1(T1c),T2加权(T2w,从2025年起非强制性),T2加权FLAIR(T2f). 地面真理标签遵循五级方案:0=背景, 1 = NETC, 2 = SNFH, 3 = ET, 4 = RC. RC(标签4)在大约13%的病例中存在,并且保留为有别于整个肿瘤(WT)等级的单独类别.

blocks.en:
Two cases contained out-of-scheme segmentation labels. One was resolved by applying the official corrected-labels overlay; the other (129 voxels affected) was not covered by that correction and was excluded from training. Excluding this single unresolved case, all remaining 1,295 annotated cases were
eligible for conversion; a further, separate set of cases was excluded at conversion time for missing one or more of the four required modalities (T2w in particular is non-mandatory and absent for several cases), following a conservative complete-modality inclusion criterion. Twenty-eight cases with all-zero segmentation masks confirmed as legitimate no-visible-disease UCSD cases per the dataset description were retained as valid negative training examples rather than treated as missing annotations.
blocks.zh:
有两个病例含有外切片标签. 其中一项是通过使用正式更正的标签来解决的;另一项(129名受感染的毒物)没有被更正,因此被排除在培训之外。 除了这个单一的未决案件外,其余的1 295个附加说明的案件都是:
根据保守的完整模式纳入标准,另外一套案件在转换时因缺少四种所需模式中的一种或一种以上(特别是T2w是非强制性的,有些情况下没有)而被排除在外。 根据数据集描述,28个带有全零分解口罩的病例被确认为合法的无可见病UCSD病例被保留为有效的负面培训实例,而不是作为缺失说明处理。

blocks.en:
Data were converted to nnU-Net raw format using standard nnU-Net
fingerprinting and automatic preprocessing. For the region-based training variant, a second version of the dataset was constructed with overlapping region labels in place of the mutually exclusive per-voxel classes used for the other models.
blocks.zh:
使用标准 nnU-Net 将数据转换为 nnU-Net 原始格式
指纹和自动预处理。 就基于区域的培训变体而言,第二版的数据集用重叠的区域标签取代了用于其他模式的相互排斥的每伏xel课程。

blocks.en: 2.2 Cross-Validation Splits and Leakage Prevention
blocks.zh: 2.2 防止分裂和渗漏

blocks.en:
The UCSD subset has a longitudinal structure where each patient contributes multiple imaging timepoints, encoded within the case identifier. Naive random splitting or modulo-based fold assignment allows the same patient to appear in both training and validation within a fold, inflating estimated performance. We instead grouped cases by patient identifier and
applied grouped 5-fold cross-validation ( GroupKFold ).
The resulting fold assignment was reused identically across all model variants for training and model selection; all reported metrics are official validation-server scores, not CV scores.
blocks.zh:
UCSD子集有一个纵向结构,每个患者在此贡献多个成像时间点,在病例标识符内编码. 直肠随机分解或基于modulo的折叠任务,可以让同一个病人在一个折叠,膨胀的估计性能中同时出现在培训和验证中. 我们用病人的身份识别和
应用分组5倍交叉验证(GroupKFold ).
由此产生的折叠任务在所有模型变体中都得到同样的再利用,用于培训和模型选择;所有报告的指标都是官方验证-服务器分数,而不是CV分数。

blocks.en: 2.3 Architectures
blocks.zh: 2.3 建筑

blocks.en: We trained and evaluated four model configurations.
blocks.zh: 我们训练和评估了四个模型配置。

blocks.en: Plain nnU-Net (Baseline). Standard 3D full-resolution nnU-Net v2 [ 3 ] with default architecture and plans. We also included an earlier, shorter-trained (200-epoch) checkpoint that predates the postprocessing correction described in Section 2.6 and differs from the 1000-epoch baseline in both training length and postprocessing.
blocks.zh: Plain nnU-Net (Baseline) (英语). 标准3D全分辨率 nnU-Net v2 [3] 有默认架构和计划. 我们还包括一个更早、更短的(200-时代)检查站,它比第2.6节所述的处理后纠正早,在培训时间和处理后都与1000-时代基线不同。

blocks.en: ResEncL. Residual Encoder Large variant [ 5 ] , trained on the label-based dataset with training configuration otherwise identical to the baseline.
blocks.zh: ResEncL. 残余编码器大变体[5],在基于标签的数据集上接受培训,培训配置与基线不同。

blocks.en: Region-Based Training. To handle overlapping region definitions (WT = {NETC, SNFH, ET}; TC = {NETC, ET}), we adopted a region-based training scheme [ 4 ] with overlapping labels in place of mutually exclusive classes, applied to Primus. We also trained a region-based ResEncL variant, but given the anomalous results with region-based Primus (Section 2.5 ), did not pursue it further and do not report it.
blocks.zh: 地区培训。 为了处理重叠的区域定义(WT = {NETC, SNFH, ET};TC = {NETC, ET}),我们通过了一项基于区域的培训计划[4],其标签重叠代替相互排斥的课程,适用于Primus。 我们还培训了一个基于区域的ResEncL变体,但鉴于基于区域的Primus(第2.5节)的反常结果,我们没有进一步追查,也没有报告。

blocks.en: Primus. A Primus (PrimusV3S) transformer model [ 13 ] , integrated as an nnU-Net v2 trainer class, trained in both label-based and region-based configurations. The label-based configuration achieved the strongest aggregate DSC/NSD among individual models (Section 3 ); reconstruction of discrete labels from the region-based configuration’s trained probabilities is described in Section 2.5 .
blocks.zh: Primus. A Primus (PrimusV3S) 变压器型号[13],集成于nnU-Net v2教练班,同时接受基于标签和基于区域配置的培训. 基于标签的配置在单个模型中实现了最强的聚合DSC/NSD(第3节);第2.5节介绍了从区域配置训练有素的概率中重建离散标签的情况。

blocks.en: 2.4 Training Configurations
blocks.zh: 2.4 培训配置

blocks.en:
All nnU-Net-based models (baseline, ResEncL, and Primus) used nnU-Net’s self-configured preprocessing and default optimization protocol, with patch size and batch size determined automatically per configuration via nnU-Net’s fingerprinting step, and deep supervision enabled by
default. Plain nnU-Net and ResEncL used the default nnUNetTrainer (SGD, Nesterov momentum 0.99, initial LR 0.01 with polynomial decay, per-sample rather than batch Dice); Primus used its dedicated nnUNet_PrimusV3S_Trainer with that trainer’s default settings. Inference used sliding-window prediction with mirroring test-time augmentation, with region probabilities binarized at 0.5. The plain nnU-Net baseline was trained for 1,000 epochs across 5 folds on an NVIDIA A100 GPU; the earlier, shorter-trained checkpoint referenced above was trained for 200 epochs. ResEncL, region-based ResEncL, and both Primus configurations were each trained for 5 folds on NVIDIA H100 SXM GPUs, with folds trained in parallel. All models were trained and evaluated on the identical patient-grouped 5-fold splits described above.
blocks.zh:
所有基于 nnU-Net 的模型(基线、ResEncL和Primus)都使用 nnU-Net 的自配置预处理和默认优化协议,通过 nnU-Net 的指纹步骤自动确定每个配置的补丁大小和批量大小,并允许进行深度监管
默认。 Plain nnU-Net和ResEncL使用默认的 nnUNetTrainer(SGD, Nesterov power 0.99),初始的 LR 0.01 带有多诺衰变,每样本而不是批量的 Dice; Primus 使用其专用的 nnUNet_PrimusV3S_Trainer 带有该教练的默认设置. 推论采用反射试验时间增强的滑窗预测,区域概率二进制为0.5。 在NVIDIA A100 GPU上,为1 000个跨5倍的世纪培训了平原NNU-Net基线;上文提到的更早、训练较短的检查站为200个世纪培训。 ResEncL,以区域为基础的ResEncL,以及两个Primus配置在NVIDIA H100 SXM GPU上分别接受了5个折叠的训练,折叠的训练是平行的. 对所有模型都进行了上述5倍相同的患者组合分数的培训和评价。

blocks.en: 2.5 Region-Order Assumption in Region-Based Label Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.5 重建区域标签的区令

blocks.en:
Region-based nnU-Net reconstructs a discrete label map from overlapping region predictions by processing regions in a declared order, with each region overwriting prior assignments where they overlap. This assumes the declared order matches the regions’ anatomical containment hierarchy, outermost to innermost. Our labeling scheme violates this under naive
ascending order: label 1 (NETC) is innermost, while label 2 (SNFH) is outermost, the reverse of what ascending order assumes. As a result, the whole-tumor region was assigned label 1 instead of label 2, inflating NETC with misclassified SNFH voxels and collapsing the tumor-core (TC) score.
We identified this via a voxel-count comparison against the label-based model’s output; the correct order applies the outer region first, then the inner tumor-core region, then the remaining independent classes.
blocks.zh:
以区域为基础的nU-Net根据所宣布的顺序,从处理区域的重叠预测中重建一个离散的标签地图,每个区域在重叠的地方覆盖先前的任务。 这假设所宣布的命令符合各地区解剖控制等级,从最外到最内层。 我们的标签计划天真地违反了这个规定
升序:标签1(NETC)最内侧,而标签2(SNFH)最外侧,是升序假设的反向. 因此,全肿瘤区域被分配到标签1,而不是标签2,将NETC与错分类的SNFH voxels充气,并崩溃肿瘤分数(TC).
我们通过与基于标签的模型的输出进行血清计数比较来确定这一点;正确的顺序首先适用于外区域,然后是内肿瘤-核区域,然后是其余的独立类别。

blocks.en: 2.6 Postprocessing
blocks.zh: 2.6 后处理

blocks.en: Initial postprocessing applied morphological opening per class, which caused lesion-wise F1 to collapse to near zero (0.01–0.02) despite reasonable DSC, since the erosion step eliminates connected components near the 27 mm 3 scoring threshold before dilation can restore them. We removed morphological opening and replaced it with connected-component filtering on physical volume: components below 27 mm 3 are discarded, plus per-class hole-filling for the ensemble. This fix alone recovered lesion-wise F1 from ∼ \sim 0.01 to ∼ \sim 0.33–0.41 across ET/TC/WT. We highlight this failure mode because morphological opening is a common postprocessing default, and its interaction with small-lesion scoring thresholds is rarely reported explicitly in prior BraTS work.
blocks.zh: 初始后处理应用了每个类的形态开口,尽管DSC是合理的,但导致损伤性F1崩溃到接近零(0.01–0.02),因为侵蚀步骤消除了接近27毫米3分阈值的连接部件,然后才能进行放大恢复. 我们取消了形态开口,取而代之的是物理体积上的连接组件过滤:27毫米3以下的组件被丢弃,加上每级的填孔,用于综艺. 单这一固定装置在ET/TC/WT中从 \sim 0.01 恢复到 \sim 0.33-0.41。 我们强调这种失败模式,因为形态开口是常见的后处理默认,它与小流积分阈值的相互作用很少在之前的BrATS工作中得到明确报告.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: Table 1 reports lesion-wise DSC and NSD, per class, for all trained configurations on the official validation leaderboard. Table 2 reports lesion-wise F1, taken directly from the official scorer’s small-instance F1 output for each submission.
blocks.zh: 表1按班级报告官方验证领导板上所有经过培训的配置的损伤情况。 表2报告的损伤为F1, 直接取自官方计分员每次提交的小分数F1产出。

blocks.en: Table 1: Lesion-wise DSC / NSD on the validation set, by class.
blocks.zh: 表1:按类别分列的审定装置上的Lesion-wise DSC / NSD.

blocks.en: Table 2: Lesion-wise F1 on the validation set, by class.
blocks.zh: 表2:按类别分列的审定装置上的Lesion-wise F1。

blocks.en: Primus (label-based) achieves the highest mean DSC/NSD across classes among individual models, leads on TC, and is the model used in our final ensemble; per-class differences among the top configurations are otherwise narrow, with the ensemble marginally ahead on WT and region-based Primus ahead on RC DSC specifically. Region-based Primus improves ET DSC/NSD (0.713/0.762 vs. 0.710/0.761) but underperforms on TC and RC NSD, a trade-off we consider a current limitation of the region-based approach. On lesion-wise F1 (Table 2 ), both Primus configurations perform similarly poorly (0.044–0.053) and are substantially outperformed by ResEncL (0.354–0.452) on ET, TC, and WT; all models score zero on RC (discussed below).
blocks.zh: Primus(基于标签)在单个模型的类别中实现最高的DSC/NSD,领先于TC,是我们最后综艺节目中使用的模型;顶级组合之间的每级差异在其他方面是狭小的,综艺节目在WT上略为领先,在RC DSC上则以区域为主的Primus具体领先. 以地区为基础的Primus改进了ET DSC/NSD(0.713/0.762 vs. 0.710/0.761),但对TC和RC NSD却表现不佳,我们考虑了目前对基于地区的方法的限制。 在损害方面,F1(表2),Primus两种配置的性能同样差(0.044-0.053),在ET、TC和WT上的ResEncL(0.354-0.452)的性能大大高于其他模式;所有型号在RC(下文讨论)上的分数为零。

blocks.en:

blocks.en:
Lesion-wise F1 reveals a starkly different pattern from DSC/NSD. ResEncL achieves the strongest lesion-wise F1 across ET/TC/WT (0.354–0.452), moderately exceeding even the nnU-Net baseline (0.331–0.423), while Primus lags far behind both (0.044–0.053) despite leading on aggregate overlap metrics. This dissociation between overlap-based accuracy and small-lesion detection is the central empirical
finding of this comparison: a model’s DSC/NSD ranking is not predictive of its small-instance detection ranking, and the two must be evaluated independently. We attribute Primus’s small-instance weakness to its transformer backbone’s coarse 3D tokenization, which operates at a spatial scale close to that of the smallest scored lesions, while ResEncL’s fully convolutional design preserves fine-grained spatial resolution better suited to sub-token-scale structures. This complementary strength profile suggests genuine architectural diversity between the two models, making them promising candidates for ensembling.
blocks.zh:
Lesion-wise F1揭示了与DSC/NSD截然不同的鲜明模式. ResEncL在ET/TC/WT(0.354-0.452)中达到最强的F1损伤,甚至略高于NNU-Net基线(0.331-0.423),而Primus则远远落后于两者(0.044-0.53),尽管在总的重叠度数上领先。 基于重叠的精确度和小液态探测之间的这种分离是中心经验
比较结果: 一个模型的DSC/NSD排名不能预测它的小型探测排名,两者必须独立评估. 我们把Primus的微弱弱点归结于其变压器骨干粗糙的3D标志化,它运行的空间尺度接近最小的积分损伤,而ResEncL的全转式设计则保存了精细的空间分辨率,更适合下位结构. 这种互补的实力特征表明两种模式之间具有真正的建筑多样性,使他们有希望成为综艺的候选者。

blocks.en: Figure 1 illustrates this dissociation qualitatively across four representative cases spanning small and large lesion scales. For small lesions, model disagreement is not uniform: in one case (90 mm 3 ), both models correctly localize and roughly match the lesion’s extent, with the discrepancy confined to a small number of boundary voxels. In another case (228 mm 3 ), however, Primus fails to detect the lesion entirely while ResEncL correctly identifies it, indicating a genuine detection failure rather than boundary-level noise, consistent with the quantitative lesion-wise F1 gap above.
blocks.zh: 图1从质量上说明了在四起具有代表性、涉及大小损伤的病例中的这种分离。 对于小的损伤,模型分歧并不一致:在一种情况下(90毫米3),两种模型都正确定位,大致与损伤程度相符,差异局限于少数的边界阴道。 然而,在另一起案件(228毫米3)中,Primus未能完全探测到损害,而ResEncL正确地识别了损害,表明存在真正的探测失败,而不是边界一级噪音,这与上面的定量损害-偏差F1是一致的。

blocks.en:
For large lesions, model behavior diverges differently. In one case (129 cm 3 ), ResEncL substitutes a substantial portion of the necrotic tumor core (NETC) with resection cavity (RC), a clinically distinct structure, while Primus’s prediction closely matches the ground-truth NETC/ET layering; we observe this substitution in this case only and report it as a case-specific failure rather than a systematic tendency. A
separate case (18 cm 3 ) illustrates a shared limitation: both models under-predict the interior enhancing/necrotic composition of a ring-shaped lesion, producing a hollow region not present in the ground
truth.
blocks.zh:
对于大型损伤,模型行为不同. 在一例(129 cm 3)中,ResEncL用一个临床上截然不同的结构(RC)取代了大部分的坏疽性肿瘤核心(NETC),而Primus的预测与地面真实的NETC/ET分层非常吻合;我们只在此情况下观察到这种替代,并把它报告为针对具体案例的失败而不是系统性的趋势。 A级
单独的病例(18 cm 3 )说明了一个共同的局限性:两种模型都预言不到环形损伤的内脏增强/内脏组成,造成地面上没有的空洞区域。
事实

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The most impactful finding is that morphological postprocessing meant to clean up predictions can suppress detection of the small lesions the evaluation penalizes most heavily. The lesion-wise F1 metric is highly sensitive to whether small components survive postprocessing, so practitioners should check postprocessing effects on the small-lesion subset specifically, not just aggregate DSC.
blocks.zh: 最有影响的发现是,旨在清理预测的形态后处理可以抑制对评价所惩罚最严重的小损害的检测。 损伤的F1度量对小组件是否在后处理中存活非常敏感,因此从业者应该具体检查小液子集的后处理效果,而不仅仅是聚合DSC.

blocks.en:
A related pattern emerges from comparing Primus and ResEncL under identical postprocessing: Primus leads on DSC/NSD, but ResEncL’s lesion-wise F1 is roughly an order of magnitude higher (e.g. ET: 0.052 vs. 0.452). Strong overlap metrics do not guarantee good small-lesion detection, and the two should be evaluated separately. Since ResEncL achieved strong DSC without losing lesion-wise F1, the two models appeared complementary, motivating our ensemble. In practice,
the ensemble’s lesion-wise F1 (e.g. ET: 0.064) stayed close to Primus’s rather than ResEncL’s, despite weighting intended to protect ResEncL’s contribution. This suggests probability-averaging ensembles do not automatically preserve a component model’s minority-case strengths: when Primus assigns near-zero probability to a lesion it misses, averaging with ResEncL’s moderate probability often still falls short of the 0.5 decision threshold. Threshold- or size-adaptive ensemble weighting may address this.
blocks.zh:
将Primus和ResEncL在相同的后处理中进行比较后出现了一种相关的模式: Primus在 DSC/NSD 上领先,但ResEncL 的损伤性F1 大约是比它更高的数量级(例如ET: 0.052 vs. 04.52)。 强重叠度量标准不能保证良好的小液态检测,两者应分别评价. 由于ResEncL实现了强大的DSC而不失去损伤感的F1,两种模型出现了互补,激发了我们的综艺. 在实践中,
尽管加权是为了保护ResEncL的贡献,但综艺节目的损伤性F1(例如ET: 0.064)仍然接近Primus的而不是ResEncL的。 这表明概率虚拟组合不会自动保留一个组件模型的少数案例的长处:当Primus将近乎零的概率分配给它错过的损伤时,在ResEncL的中度概率平均仍然低于0.5决定阈值。 阈值-或大小-适应性共振加权法可能解决这个问题。

blocks.en: ResEncL also shows a distinct weakness on RC (DSC 0.415, the lowest of the individually-trained models), despite sitting between the nnU-Net baseline and Primus elsewhere. RC is a single, well-defined cavity rather than a small multifocal structure, so this is likely a separate, unexplained effect rather than the same cause as Primus’s small-lesion gap.
blocks.zh: ResEncL还显示出驻地协调员的明显弱点(DSC 0.415, 个人训练模式中最低的),尽管它位于NNU-Net基线和其他地方的Primus之间。 RC是一个单一的,定义清晰的腔体,而不是一个小的多焦结构,因此这很可能是一个单独的,无法解释的效果,而不是与Primus的小型流体间隙相同的原因.

blocks.en:
The under-detection pattern (false negatives outweighing false
positives) seen in cross-validation points toward foreground
oversampling, false-negative-weighted losses such as Tversky loss, or a two-stage cascade as likely next steps. Given Primus’s shortfall sits in the same small-lesion regime, we consider a two-stage cascade the highest-priority
next experiment.

blocks.en: RC remains a weakness across our pipeline. ResEncL performs worst (DSC 0.415), the nnU-Net baseline partially compensates (0.478), and region-based Primus achieves the highest RC DSC among our models (0.566), though label-based Primus leads RC NSD (0.436); even the best of these falls well short of competitive pipelines. Official small-instance scoring shows zero true positives for small resection-cavity instances ( ∼ \sim 1.17 per case, averaged) across every model we submitted – nnU-Net, ResEncL, both Primus configurations, and the ensemble, indicating a small-RC detection failure that is universal across architectures rather than specific to any one model.
blocks.zh: 驻地协调员仍然是我们整个管道的一个弱点。 ResEncL表现最差(DSC 0.415),nnU-Net基线部分补偿(0.478),基于区域的Primus在我们的模式中实现了最高的RC DSC(0.566),尽管基于标签的Primus领先RC NSD(0.436);即使这些最好的都远远低于竞争性管道. 官方小事件评分显示,在我们提交的每个模型中(每例为\\\sim 1.17,平均),NNU-Net、ResEncL(既包括Primus配置,也包括综艺节目)中,小事件段-cavity实例的真实阳性为零(X\sim 1.17,平均),这表明小事件段-RC检测失败是跨越架构的,而不是针对任何一个模型的。

blocks.en:
Our region-based training pipeline surfaces a labeling-order
assumption in nnU-Net’s region reconstruction (Section 2.5 ) likely to recur in other setups where label containment order does not match ascending label values.

blocks.en: Open items. (1) NSD tolerance in our offline evaluator is unverified against the official scoring script. (2) The lesion matching rule is unconfirmed against the official evaluator. (3) Missing-T2w validation cases are excluded at inference, which may cause silent score drag.
blocks.zh: 开放项目。 (1) 我们的离线评价员对官方评分脚本的ND容忍度未经核实。 (2) 官方评价员的损伤比对规则未经证实。 (3)缺失-T2w验证案例排除推论,可能导致无声积分拖动.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We compared four segmentation configurations for BraTS-METS 2026 Task 1, trained with patient-grouped CV and evaluated on the official validation leaderboard, finding that Primus and ResEncL showed complementary strongholds: Primus led on aggregate DSC/NSD, while ResEncL led substantially on lesion-wise F1, with neither model unambiguously best across both. Our probability-averaging ensemble only partially captured this complementarity, suggesting a more targeted ensembling strategy e.g. size- or threshold-adaptive weighting could recover more of ResEncL’s small-lesion strength without sacrificing Primus’s overlap accuracy. Future work includes such adaptive ensembling, a two-stage cascade for the small-lesion regime, and anatomical hierarchy enforcement for RC detection.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了BRATS-METS 2026任务1的四个分区配置,训练有病人组合的CV,并在官方验证领导板上评价,发现Primus和ResEncL表现出了互补的据点: Primus领导了综合DSC/NSD,而ResEncL则在很大程度上领导了针对损伤的F1, 两个模型中都没有完全最好的模型。 我们的概率效应组合只是部分地抓住了这种互补性,这表明更有针对性的组合策略,例如大小或阈值适应加权可以恢复更多的ResEncL小口径的强度,而不牺牲Primus的重叠精度。 今后的工作包括适应性齐全、小液态制度的两阶段级联、以及RC检测的解剖等级强制执行。
